title: Glowing slice of pizza
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Glow halo -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="64" rx="38" ry="28" fill="#ffb347" opacity="0.18"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="64" rx="28" ry="20" fill="#ffcc66" opacity="0.22"/>

  <!-- Crust (back edge) -->
  <path d="M20 28 Q50 12 80 28 Q80 36 74 38 Q50 26 26 38 Q20 36 20 28 Z" fill="#d98c3f"/>
  <path d="M22 29 Q50 15 78 29 Q78 34 73 36 Q50 24 27 36 Q22 34 22 29 Z" fill="#f0b05e"/>

  <!-- Pizza body (cheese) -->
  <path d="M26 38 Q50 26 74 38 L50 86 Z" fill="#ffd966"/>
  <path d="M30 40 Q50 30 70 40 L50 82 Z" fill="#ffe680"/>

  <!-- Cheese highlight -->
  <path d="M40 44 Q50 36 60 44 L50 70 Z" fill="#fff2a8" opacity="0.6"/>

  <!-- Sauce peeking at edges -->
  <path d="M26 38 L50 86 L74 38 Q68 44 62 46 Q50 40 38 46 Q32 44 26 38 Z" fill="#e8563a" opacity="0.35"/>

  <!-- Pepperoni slices -->
  <circle cx="43" cy="52" r="6" fill="#e0453a"/>
  <circle cx="43" cy="52" r="4.5" fill="#f2624f"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="60" r="6" fill="#e0453a"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="60" r="4.5" fill="#f2624f"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="72" r="5" fill="#e0453a"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="72" r="3.6" fill="#f2624f"/>

  <!-- Small pepperoni highlights -->
  <circle cx="41" cy="50" r="1.5" fill="#ff9a85"/>
  <circle cx="56" cy="58" r="1.5" fill="#ff9a85"/>
  <circle cx="48.5" cy="70" r="1.2" fill="#ff9a85"/>

  <!-- Crust glow highlight -->
  <path d="M24 30 Q50 16 76 30" stroke="#ffe08a" stroke-width="2" fill="none" opacity="0.7" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Glow rays from slice -->
  <g opacity="0.5" stroke="#ffd966" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round">
    <line x1="26" y1="26" x2="20" y2="20"/>
    <line x1="50" y1="14" x2="50" y2="7"/>
    <line x1="74" y1="26" x2="80" y2="20"/>
    <line x1="20" y1="50" x2="12" y2="50"/>
    <line x1="80" y1="50" x2="88" y2="50"/>
  </g>
</svg>
